w: Before attending the main evening assembly, Swamishri addressed 400 spiritually inclined visitors and aspirants.
In his evening's discourse Swamishri highlighted the importance of righteous living and business ethics.
Swamishri was honored by the Mayor of Rajkot, Shri Ashokbhai Dangar, with the title of 'Sant Shiromani' and the 'The Best Citizen Award'. Lord Harikrishna Maharaj was honored by a devotee.
A week prior to the Joli utsav, a symbolic Joli utsav was held in the presence of Swamishri. Swamishri pulled the kite-string to the rejoicement of devotees.
The first day of the 3-day Swaminarayan Mahamantra Bicentenary Celebrations. (News report)
At 6.00 p.m. 28,000 devotees attended the assembly.
Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of murtis for the hari mandirs in the villages of Sarol and Tichkiya.

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.
26 December 2005, Surat

A devotee of Tadad village performed an 85-hour waterless fast for Swamishri’s good health. His wife and two children performed a fast for one day. Fifteen children pilgrimaged by foot from Segvachha village.

Two hundred and seventeen devotes pilgrimaged by foot from the villages of Kudiyana, Kapasi and others.

Prayasvinbhai, owner of the Madhubhan Resort, was sitting before Swamishri. Speaking about his business, he told Swamishri, "I wish that as we progress, our employees also progress. And you will be surprised to know that I myself am the leader of the employees' union. They tell me themselves that I give them even more than they expected. And I too believe these are my own people; then where is the difference? And they look after me just as much."

Swamishri said, "They are the ones doing the work, so you should see it as a partnership, shouldn't you! And if you take this much care, they will feel the company is their own too. Sometimes you will have to tell them things, but not to put them down; with love, to help them grow. This is a very good way."
Swamishri seemed to show a timeless way of human relationships.
